summary: Completed live API and browser testing for catalogue, navigation, enquiry workflows, persistence, mobile menu, and overflow. Core flows passed; the Dates catalogue filter is broken because UI and API category names differ.

integration_issues.issue: Dates filter displays 0 products even though Dates is present in the catalogue. The UI uses 'Dates' while the API product category is 'Dates & Dry Fruits'; the adjacent Dry Fruits filter also has no matching API category.

action_items: Align frontend category labels/URL values with backend product categories, or normalize the API taxonomy, so Dates and Dry Fruits filters return the intended products.
critical_code_review_comments: The shared category taxonomy is duplicated in App.js and server.py without a contract or normalization, allowing filters to silently return empty results.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST API Buyer plus UI quote, B2B, export, and contact enquiries to verify POST/GET persistence; no seeded production records were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live API suite passed root, products, three category filters, enquiry persistence, and validation. Browser checks passed all main navigation routes, product detail quote prefill, quote/B2B/export/contact submissions, mobile menu, and 390px overflow. Recheck Dates and Dry Fruits filters after taxonomy fix.
rca of the issue: App.js defines categories as Whole Spices, Spice Powders, Makhana, Dry Fruits, Dates, and Seeds & Specialty. server.py returns the dates product with category 'Dates & Dry Fruits' and has no separate Dry Fruits category. Products filtering compares exact strings, so both UI links produce an empty result set.
